page_title: MNU 3-2 LIV | Manchester Utd v Liverpool 03/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) squandered a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He blazed it high over the bar.
90+6' Substitution. Leny Yoro (Manchester United) replaces Bruno Fernandes.
90+4' A cross by Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
90+3' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
87' Arne Slot has decided to substitute Ibrahima Konate and he is replaced by Federico Chiesa (Liverpool).
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) will replace Matheus Cunha.
87' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
85' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

85' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Senne Lammens pulls off an easy save.
84' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
83' The attendance for today's match is 74027.
82' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
81' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren England had an easy-decision to make.

77' 3 - 2 Goal! Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Frederick Woodman is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 3:2.
75' Michael Carrick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) replacing Bryan Mbeumo.
75' Substitution. Jeremie Frimpong walks off the pitch and Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) comes on as a substitute.
75' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
75' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) slams the ball from a long-range free kick. He should have curled it higher to avoid hitting the wall.
73' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul. Liverpool are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

72' Casemiro (Manchester United) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the goal, but Frederick Woodman keeps it out.
70' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
70' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
68' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
68' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) was too forceful with his tackle and Darren England interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Liverpool are awarded a free kick.

64' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Senne Lammens. This effort really didn't trouble him.
63' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
63' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Liverpool.
59' Today's match ends for Andrew Robertson who will be replaced by Milos Kerkez (Liverpool).
56' 2 - 2 It's 2:2! Dominik Szoboszlai feeds Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
56' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
54' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.
50' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
49' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) picks up a yellow card.

47' 2 - 1 Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) scores with a great individual effort! He makes a good run, skips past defenders and smashes the ball from the edge of the box past the diving goalkeeper. His low drive went into the bottom left corner. Absolutely phenomenal!
47' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) blows a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the left post.
47' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) will take a corner kick.
46' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him. Manchester Utd get a corner.
46' Half-time substitution. Michael Carrick decided to make a change. Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) is replaced by Amad Diallo.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
45+2' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
45+2' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Now Manchester Utd have a corner.
45+1' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards the middle of the goal and the goalkeeper makes an easy save.
44' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
43' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Bryan Mbeumo, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.
42' The shot by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Senne Lammens.
40' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) commits a rough foul. Darren England stops the game and makes a call.
38' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
36' 39:61 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
32' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
31' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Darren England blows for a foul.
29' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it well wide of the right post.
27' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) comes close to scoring. He peels away from his marker and gets on the end of a cross from Bryan Mbeumo, but he hits a shot just wide of the right post.
26' Darren England has a clear sight and sees a foul from Casemiro (Manchester United).
24' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
22' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
20' Neat passing move from Liverpool in order to create new attacking opportunities.
17' Referee Darren England points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) goes wild in celebration.
16' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Manchester Utd players aren’t happy.

14' 2 - 0 The ball finds its way to Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) after a confusing situation inside the goalmouth. He finds some space and easily knocks the ball in with his body and alters the score to 2:0.
11' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

6' 1 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Frederick Woodman, so the score changes to 1:0.
6' Corner kick. Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) is ready to send the ball into the box.
6' An attempted cross from Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester Utd can continue in their attacking effort.
5' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Benjamin Sesko, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
3' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
1' The first half has just begun.
Liverpool will kick-off.
Darren England will officiate today.
